body.title: Playwright Mark Up Report currency field locators
body.summary: Broad div.filter on Mark Up Report matches wrong inputs (Total Perimeter instead of Subcontractor Cost). Use getByText(label) + ancestor div xpath for number input. Prefer Subcontractor Cost +$5000 under Outside Costs.
body.canonicalQuestion: How do I change Mark Up Report grand total in Playwright without editing Total Perimeter?
alternateQuestions: Which pricing field should PG e2e bump to move grand total reliably?
